opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship 2027

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000 (stated for the 2026 programme); includes a £1,000 financial incentive to part cover replacement labour cost

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Young people aged 18-24, resident in the UK, with a demonstrable interest in the relevant industry (e.g. dairy, regenerative agriculture, pig).
opportunities.summary: A 30-day fully funded study tour for young people aged 18-24, linking successful applicants directly to farmers via the Nuffield Scholar network to develop young talent in the farming industry. Includes all travel and subsistence, attendance at the Nuffield Conference, and Nuffield Farming Associate membership. For 2027, three dairy and three pig scholarships are planned.
